description: This file defines template classes for 3D and 2D tables used in engine control software, including methods for initialization, value retrieval, and table manipulation. It also declares external functions and type definitions related to engine parameter mapping.

classes.name: Map3D
classes.description: Template class representing a 3D map with methods for initialization, value retrieval, and setting all values.

classes.name: Table2D
classes.description: Template class representing a 2D table with pre-calculation of interpolation coefficients.

methods.name: Map3D::Map3D
methods.description: Constructs a Map3D object with optional multiplier.

methods.name: Map3D::create
methods.description: Initializes the Map3D object with a name and multiplier.

methods.name: Map3D::init
methods.description: Initializes the table pointers and bin data for the Map3D object.

methods.name: Map3D::getValue
methods.description: Retrieves interpolated value from the 3D map based on RPM and load.

methods.name: Map3D::setAll
methods.description: Sets all pointers in the map to a specified value.

methods.name: Table2D::preCalc
methods.description: Pre-calculates interpolation coefficients based on bin and value arrays.
